input.text: Before final delivery, tighten one installed-CLI coverage assertion: check_runtime_and_cli currently uses prior.json and asserts only generic BLOCKED for missing/invalid predecessor. cloud_contracts.verify_local_context also requires the canonical specs/<feature>/verification/T-NNN/cloud/<run>/<unit>/<file> predecessor path, so a guard regression could be masked by that unrelated path rejection; prepare/apply are also blanket OPERATION_UNIMPLEMENTED in the local public CLI. Use a canonical predecessor evidence path with a valid structurally matched local receipt control (local route integrity only, never claim saved-file authority), then assert the actual missing/invalid predecessor error versus the matched route PASS through the installed CLI. Preserve the explicitly separate in-process authenticated-deadline probe and no-executor prepare/apply denial. No need to fabricate governed CI or change runtime semantics. This is bounded coverage clarification for T007 Done When, not new scope. Re-run the changed installed suite and relevant final evidence; do not rewrite historical Red. Root owns formal review.
